recover_pose — 3D two_view op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → pose

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.recover_pose(pts1, pts2, K1, K2=None, planar_tol=0.01) (to call the implementation directly, import twoview; twoview.recover_pose(pts1, pts2, K1, K2=None, planar_tol=0.01); from the registry, ops3d.get("recover_pose"))

Usage

Recover the relative pose (R,t) and the 3-D structure from correspondences and K (disambiguated by cheirality). → (R, t_unit, points3d).

t is defined only up to scale, so it is a unit vector. points3d is in the cam1 frame (at the scale corresponding to |t|=1).

fail-closed: planar (coplanar 3D) / pure-rotation scenes are degenerate configurations of essential-matrix decomposition: the Sampson residual stays ~0 while a wrong translation direction is returned (it looks perfect). Since the pose cannot be recovered from such input, it is rejected explicitly with ValueError (use homography decomposition). planar_tol is a scale-invariant planarity threshold (degenerate if the return value of _planar_degeneracy_ratio is below it).

Procedure:

• Entry check (at least 8 points, matching point counts, (N,2) and finite).

• Planarity: fit a homography H by normalised DLT, and compute the ratio of the median symmetric transfer residual to the spread of the points in both images (sum of the mean distances from the centroids). If it is below planar_tol (default 1e-2), ValueError. If H is singular, the ratio is taken as 0 and likewise rejected.

• essential_8point → decompose into 4 candidates (R, ±t) → triangulate for each candidate and take the candidate with the most points at depth > 0 in both cameras (on a tie, the earlier candidate).

Returns: R (3,3), t (3,) unit vector, points3d (N,3). Convention: cam1 = K1[I|0], cam2 = K2[R|t], X2 = R X1 + t. points3d is in the cam1 frame at the scale |t|=1. Correspondences with parallel lines of sight become NaN rows.

• If K2 is omitted, K1 is used for both images.

• Defenceless against outliers (no RANSAC). Remove mismatches upstream.

• Deterministic. GT verification with pose_error, residuals with sampson_distance.
